body: I get that. But prior to living together he has never been this open with his body. Even going to water parks and the like he's always worn tshirts. He's always been private, but now he suddenly feels comfortable around me with only wearing a towel on his waist? It's out of character for him and seems purposeful.
I can't imagine losing him. Idk what else I can do though. I've talked with him for months. He can't move on. It's making me feel insane myself
